'Extended Lojbanic Grammar' is the reference grammar of [[La Bangu]], Lojban dialect developed by [[Fancy Generation Lojbanists|Lojbanic community]] in IRC chat #lojban. Compared to [[CLL]] is more bulky.

ELG is to be written mostly in simple Lojban. Many borrowings from English are expected. Many parts of ELG are based on CLL.
